study.question: With scorer action coordinates fixed to zero, does count-weighted pooled action content retain most of the value-only click-AUC utility, or are actions in the five target/ordinal residual summaries necessary; which path accounts for the task-index versus bank-mean readout advantage?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g1-r0025-action_value_task reaches click AUC 0.6662444305 versus g1-r0024-token_zero_task 0.6411900073 (difference +0.0250544232), whereas scorer-only g1-r0025-action_score_task reaches 0.6541741279. Adding scorer actions to value actions reaches incumbent g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached 0.6667535475, only +0.0005091171; the scorer/value AUC interaction is -0.0124750036. Shared analogues are 0.6647487996, 0.6407085599, 0.6538463868, and 0.6649937087 (interaction -0.0128929178). These are descriptive fixed-seed validation outcomes, not repeated mechanism evidence. Provisional mechanism: the pooled action channel carries much of the useful low-order feedback composition, while the five centered target-match/ordinal action summaries supply a smaller complement whose value may depend on residual-bank readout. Existing value-only experiments entangle these two channels. This study localizes their conditional utility; it makes no originality or all-task improvement claim. The incumbent auxiliary AUCs 0.778878/0.787612/0.757167 are lower than DIN 0.849070/0.864897/0.870182, so click selection must remain distinct from multi-task utility.

study.proposed_difference: Replace the prior aggregate action_in_values switch with independent action_in_pool and action_in_summaries controls, keeping action_in_scorer=False. A projection retains every item coordinate and either preserves or exactly zeros the trailing action coordinates. It is applied at both primary/auxiliary pooled-value consumers and separately once before construction of all five summaries. Four standalone modules are pool-only/task, summary-only/task, pool-only/shared, summary-only/shared. Together with existing value-only/task and value-only/shared (both channels on), and zero-token/task and zero-token/shared (both channels off), they complete a 2x2x2 pool-action x summary-action x bank-readout table at zero scorer actions. The all-off bridge also replaces action IDs/embeddings with zeros to preserve absent action-gradient graph behavior. All-on/off bridges are host prerequisites before historical endpoints count as matched controls.
predictions: Notation A[p,s,r] is full-population click AUC with pooled action p, summary action s and routing r. Historical A[1,1,task]=0.6662444304756373 and A[0,0,task]=0.6411900073135032; shared endpoints are 0.6647487996065942 and 0.6407085598818172. Existing endpoints are admissible only after bridge checks.

Primary directional prediction: A[1,0,r]-A[0,0,r] exceeds A[0,1,r]-A[0,0,r] for both readouts. Report both gains, both conditional gains A[1,1,r]-A[0,1,r] and A[1,1,r]-A[1,0,r], and pool x summary interaction I[r]=A[1,1,r]-A[1,0,r]-A[0,1,r]+A[0,0,r]. AUC decompositions are descriptive score interactions, not percentages of a causal mechanism.

A small five-summary complement would give positive A[1,1,r]-A[1,0,r]. A difference of 0.001 absolute AUC is a predeclared practical screening flag only, not an equivalence margin justified by seed variance or a significance threshold. Report raw smaller effects and do not declare equivalence from one seed.

For routing, report D[p,s]=A[p,s,task]-A[p,s,shared], D[1,0]-D[0,0], D[0,1]-D[0,0], and I[task]-I[shared]. Existing D[1,1]=0.0014956308690431 and D[0,0]=0.0004814474316860 do not identify which channel contributes. If D[1,0] alone retains the extra gap, pooled inputs suffice for that readout interaction; if D[0,1] alone retains it, summaries are implicated conditionally.

All four modules should have the same 32129765 total / 31793216 embedding / 336549 dense parameters as their ancestors; this is a source-derived prediction awaiting host measurement. Small projection overhead is expected, not an equal-compute guarantee.

Report all four task AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean, train/allocated GPU/wall seconds, processed examples, peak memory, inference throughput and batch p50/p95 latency. Reuse prespecified empty,1-16,17-64,>64 history slices with sample/positive/negative counts (6444/427/6017;461684/28818/432866;1001754/55298/946456;1401885/50957/1350928). falsifiers: The pooled-dominance hypothesis is weakened or reversed if summary-only recovers as much or more click utility consistently, or removing summary actions from the both-on endpoint causes the larger loss. A promising but unsuccessful summary implementation motivates a scale/optimization replacement control rather than refuting structured action utility.

If neither isolated channel retains utility but both-on does, joint dependence rather than pooled sufficiency is indicated. If both isolated channels match both-on within observed variation, the channels may be redundant; one seed cannot establish equivalence.

If routing gaps remain unchanged across channel assignments, there is no evidence here that summary actions drive the readout interaction. Opposite gaps or unstable repeated outcomes weaken the directional account.

Any failure of host all-on/all-off endpoint parity, masked-input/target-action invariance, gradient ownership, parameter/buffer parity or finite forward/backward invalidates the matched interpretation. Correct code and retain all failed/preflight costs; do not substitute a looser contract.

If paired repetitions or authorized user-cluster intervals fail to support a consequential difference, retain a preliminary or null conclusion. Nominal capacity matching or the existing global brand-code replacement alone cannot eliminate optimization/effective-rank explanations.

Prior declarations documented provenance; local scorer/value outcomes do not establish INFNet effectiveness. Its multi-mask hub initialization confirms why preserved masks leave feedback information after token-channel interventions.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No INFNet hub/broadcast mechanism adopted. New change splits historical action coordinates between inherited weighted pooled values and five centered residual summaries, crossed with existing bank readout.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No layer-wise categorical/sequence/task hubs, aggregation or gated broadcasts. Source inspected is the pinned benchmark adaptation, not verified original-paper/author-code equivalence; no priority claim.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If a new channel accidentally changes original action-derived masks, permits unmasked history or cannot pass endpoint/perturbation isolation checks, conditional path attribution fails. A source-to-code declaration is not causal evidence of knowledge value.
